plan.objective: Make account search match on email address as well as name
plan.intent: Enable an additional match field in searchAccounts: broaden the existing case-insensitive substring filter from account.name only to account.name OR account.email, tolerating accounts that lack either field, while preserving the current empty/whitespace-query behavior of returning an empty array; extend test/search.test.js with email-match coverage and touch no other module.

plan.objective: Round every amount a customer is shown to whole pence so totals never display long decimals
plan.intent: Change customer-facing money rounding precision from whole pounds to whole pence by setting the PLACES constant in src/format/money.js from 0 to 2, so roundMoney and formatMoney (and orderTotal, which already delegates to roundMoney) emit two-decimal amounts; update test/money.test.js to pin the two-decimal behaviour it currently leaves deliberately unasserted. Behaviour is modified, not added or removed; no other module handles amounts and no other module's tests are touched.

plan.objective: Retry webhook delivery up to three times when the transport reports a failure
expectedSchemas: webhook delivery result object: { url: string, delivered: boolean } (may gain an attempts count)
plan.intent: Add retry behavior to the existing webhook deliver() in src/notify/webhook.js: when the injected transport reports failure (response.ok is not true), re-invoke it so delivery is attempted up to three times total, stopping at the first success and reporting delivered:false only after all attempts fail. No removal or disabling of existing behavior — the { url, delivered } result shape and single-success path are preserved, and only src/notify/webhook.js plus its own test/webhook.test.js are touched, per the README rule that a module change must not require editing another module's tests. No new dependencies, config keys, services, or network access.
